methodology_lesson_16_new.name: Compose falsifiers via manual end-to-end replication
methodology_lesson_16_new.description: When apr eval reports FAIL on a problem the model clearly solves correctly, the bug is in the harness. To find it: manually replicate the entire apr eval flow (prompt → model → extract → test) outside the binary. If manual replication passes but harness fails, the gap is somewhere in the harness flow's specific implementation, not in any of the individual steps.
